<script>
ENCODING = "MS949"


def fix(p):
    path = "module/comp-jar/pom.xml"
    pom = p.pom(path)
    if pom.get_property("project.build.sourceEncoding") == ENCODING:
        p.log(f"{path}: project.build.sourceEncoding already {ENCODING}")
        return
    pom.set_property("project.build.sourceEncoding", ENCODING)
    pom.save()
    p.log(f"{path}: project.build.sourceEncoding {ENCODING} (cp949 sources)")
</script>
